name: Ilvane
title: Keeper of the Everflame
examine: She tends a fire that needs no tending and has for longer than the roads have had names. Ask her what the flame burns and she will say: nothing. That is the point.
lines: The flame burns nothing. It has never needed anything. I keep it company, not alive.
Every road lamp south of here is a daughter of a daughter of this light. The lamps do not know it.
The mother-flame at Silverfall is the youngest daughter. Tell Sella she is doing it right.
